dense_rule: A resolved descending trial with trial-phase packing fraction >= 0.10 is a dense split, independent of declared trial kind.
gas_rule: A resolved descending trial with packing fraction < 0.10 is gas evolution.
ambiguity_rule: Stop for owner decision if a descending trial lies between 0.05 and 0.35; these delimit the separation supported by the retained diagnosis.
basis: Issue 222 diagnosis-phase-search: gas max 0.02509233038155006; dense probes 0.40–0.46. Threshold declared before any new refit endpoint is computed or read.
rounding: Report support-reconstruction-only failures; check each affected state with an ion-free trial; other unresolved trials block gate
selection: Lowest cost among density-gate-passing endpoints per variant, retained before outside-fit statistics
